test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 3 Mar 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The _______ takes the decision to declare any bill to be a money bill.

options.text: Governor of the Reserve bank of India

solution:
The correct answer is __**Speaker of the Lok Sabha.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to **Article 110 **of the Indian Constitution, a Money Bill is defined as a bill that deals exclusively with matters related to taxation, public expenditure, or borrowing, and the **Speaker has the authority to determine whether a bill qualifies as a Money Bill.**
 
• A **Money Bill can only be introduced in the Lok Sabha,** not in the Rajya Sabha.
 
• After it is passed by the Lok Sabha, it is sent to the Rajya Sabha for consideration, but the **Rajya Sabha must return it to the Lok Sabha within 14 days. **
 
• The **Rajya Sabha (Council of States) cannot amend or reject a Money Bill**. It can only make recommendations on it, which the Lok Sabha may or may not accept.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 Article 89
 The Vice President of India serves as the Chairman.
 Can be removed by a process similar to impeachment under Article 67(b).
 
 

 Speaker of the Lok Sabha
 Article 93
 Elected by members of the Lok Sabha.
 Can be removed by a no-confidence motion.
 
 

 Governor of the Reserve Bank of India
 Section 7 of the RBI Act
 Appointed by the Government of India.
 Can be removed by the Government before the completion of their term.
